title: Quick Steamed Portuguese Wild Garlic Leaf Wrap
description: A tangy and bouncy Portuguese dish featuring wild garlic leaves, perfect for the monsoon season, this diabetic-friendly recipe is steamed to perfection in a terracotta dish.
instructions: Rinse the wild garlic leaves in cold water and pat them dry with a paper towel.
In a small bowl, mix together olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, salt, and black pepper.
Brush the mixture evenly onto the center of each wild garlic leaf.
Place the leaves in a terracotta dish, leaving some space between each leaf.
Pour the water into the bottom of the terracotta dish, making sure not to get any water on the leaves.
Cover the dish with a lid and steam the leaves over medium heat for 5 minutes.
Remove the dish from the heat and let it cool for a minute or two.
Serve the steamed wild garlic leaves hot, wrapped around your favorite filling.
